correctness.rationale: The five-by-five precision is SPD for \(\mu>0\) and \(0<w<1\). Symbolic inversion gives the three diagonal orbit formulas, the inverse derivative gives the exact Nyström trace-gain score, and the two rational comparisons have strictly positive denominators. The quartic is strictly increasing; the sextic has exactly one positive sign change. A derivative identity at the first crossing proves the ordering and all optimality ties. An extracted exact checker independently reconstructs the formulas and passed 871 checks; finite checks are supplementary.

originality.rationale: The claim is a complete two-threshold optimizer phase diagram for a single Nyström landmark on a five-cycle with one strictly weakened edge. Inspected general Nyström and Gaussian sensor design results define the objectives, but do not derive the two positive-root polynomials, the global strict ordering of their roots, or all optimizer ties throughout \(0<w<1\). Publicly indexed closest defective-cycle sensor work considers observability, not trace-residual minimization. Risk remains from specialized and unindexed results.
residual_risks: The search was bounded and cannot exclude unindexed equivalent exact results.
Specialized Gaussian Markov field optimal-design monographs, proofs, or appendices were not exhaustively inspected.
A general theorem for all defective cyclic precision matrices may imply the present five-vertex case without matching terminology.

value.rationale: This gives a complete exact minimal three-orbit symmetry-breaking cycle benchmark for the disagreement of observed entropy and total posterior variance objectives, including the intermediate optimal sensor class that a simple low/high screening comparison misses. The explicit crossings and equality cases are useful for checking Gaussian field landmark-selection heuristics; this is a finite natural design invariant, not a generic linear algebra exercise.
